newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU clears bids to export about 500,000 T flour.
newsitem.headline: EU clears bids to export about 500,000 T flour.

text.p: The European Union has accepted bids by European flour firms to export around 500,000 tonnes of soft wheat flour under licences carrying a refund of 27 Ecus per tonne, EU grain officials said on Wednesday.
"Bids were placed for approximatively 500,000 tonnes of flour. They were all accepted," one official said.
Flour firms had applied for the licences last week just before the EU cut the daily refund on flour exports to 22 Ecus from 27 Ecus.
In France flour firms had bid to export some 100,000 tonnes of flour, ONIC officials have said.
Flour firms apparently placed large export bids in Italy and Spain but there were no details on the volumes sought, officials said.

Latest European Union figures showed EU flour export commitments bewteen July 1 and November 12 reached 2.063 million tonnes (grain equivalent) down from 2.697 million during the same period last year.
But this latest flour award should bring EU flour export commitments into line with last year's levels, that is around 2.8 million tonnes (grain equivalent), EU grain officials said.
